bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText: [Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 174 (Tuesday, November 17, 2026)][House]From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]By Mr. MOOLENAAR:H.R. 11047.Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuantto the following:Article I, Section 8, Clause 1 of the Constitution, whichempowers Congress to provide for the common Defense and toset the terms on which Federal funds are expended; Clauses12, 13, and 14, which empower Congress to raise and supportArmies, to provide and maintain a Navy, and to make Rules forthe Government and Regulation of the land and naval Forces;and Clause 18, which empowers Congress to make all Lawsnecessary and proper for carrying the foregoing powers intoexecution.[Page H6257]

dublinCore.dc:description: This file contains bill summaries and statuses for federal legislation. A bill summary describes the most significant provisions of a piece of legislation and details the effects the legislative text may have on current law and federal programs. Bill summaries are authored by the Congressional Research Service (CRS) of the Library of Congress. As stated in Public Law 91-510 (2 USC 166 (d)(6)), one of the duties of CRS is "to prepare summaries and digests of bills and resolutions of a public general nature introduced in the Senate or House of Representatives". For more information, refer to the User Guide that accompanies this file.
